svg.title: An update, from the recipe to the running system
svg.desc: sudo nomira build builds the recipe. If a step or a check fails, nothing is published and the running system stays as it is. Otherwise the image is published to /var/lib/nomira/system.oci. sudo bootc upgrade stages it as a new deployment, which starts with the next boot, or with a soft reboot when kernel, initramfs and kernel arguments stay the same. The previous system stays in the boot menu, and bootc rollback goes back to it.
